privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires adding three locators to the 'HQ Warehouse'. The specific Search Keys are 'OV-01-01', 'OV-01-02', and 'OV-01-03'. Their coordinates (X, Y, Z) must be (1, 1, 1), (1, 1, 2), and (1, 1, 3) respectively. All locators must have the 'Active' checkbox enabled. In iDempiere, Locators are typically a sub-tab or child record of the Warehouse window.
